19.t: Working with data: a fuel for a camping stove
q: Which fuel gives the most energy per gram?
Calculate the energy per 1000 VND for each fuel.
Explain why mass matters for a hiker more than for a family at home.
A hiker carries the fuel: more energy per gram means a lighter load for the same cooking.
Recommend a fuel for a three-day hike, using at least three columns.
Butane: highest energy per gram (lightest), no soot, least CO₂ per kJ. It costs more per kJ than wax, but wax is heavier and sooty. Accept a justified other choice.
